questions.text: Which part of a plant grows underground and drinks up water from the soil?
questions.subject: SCIENCE
questions.explanation:
The **roots** are the hidden helpers of the plant. They act like tiny straws that soak up **water** and **nutrients** from the dirt. Without roots, a plant would fall over and get very thirsty! 
* They anchor the plant in place. 
* They store food for later. 
* They help the plant stay strong.

questions.text: What do we call the big, bright star that gives our planet heat and light?
questions.subject: SCIENCE
questions.explanation:
The **Sun** is actually a giant, glowing ball of hot gas right in the center of our **solar system**. It is much bigger than the Earth! 
* It provides the **energy** plants need to grow. 
* It keeps our world warm enough for us to live. 
* It is the reason we have daytime.

questions.text: Which of these is a liquid state of matter?
questions.subject: SCIENCE
questions.explanation:
A **liquid** is something that can flow and change its shape to fit the container it is in. 
* **Water** can pour from a pitcher into a glass. 
* Solids like rocks keep their own shape no matter where you put them. 
* Liquids are fun because they are always ready to splash and move!

questions.text: What do caterpillars turn into after they build a chrysalis?
questions.subject: SCIENCE
questions.explanation:
This amazing change is called **metamorphosis**. The caterpillar builds a cozy home called a **chrysalis** to rest inside. 
* Inside, its body changes shape completely. 
* Eventually, it pops out as a beautiful **butterfly**. 
* It is like a real-life magic trick in nature!

questions.text: Which sense do you use to tell if something is soft or hard?
questions.subject: SCIENCE
questions.explanation:
Your sense of **touch** comes from the skin all over your body. Your hands are especially good at feeling textures! 
* If you touch a fluffy pillow, your brain knows it is **soft**. 
* If you touch a brick, your brain knows it is **hard**. 
* This sense helps you explore the world safely every single day.
